title: Switch a project from metric to imperial: units, dimension types, notes and view scales
use_when: a project set up in metric must show feet and inches
dimensions show two values (metric with imperial alternate) and should show one
view scales must change to the nearest imperial scale
not_for: converting geometry: the model stays as built; only display and annotation change
